description: (needs account token) Set how a site appears in search results and when shared: name, brand colour, search title and description, share title and description. Site-wide, or for one of its domains with domain. Works once the site has its own domain. No money. Never buy anything without asking me. Never buy a domain, email or subscription for me without asking first. When something costs money, give me the payment link and let me pay.

domain.description: Optional: apply to this one domain of the site only.

serp_description.description: Optional: the description in search results.

serp_title.description: Optional: the title in search results.

share_description.description: Optional: the description when the link is shared.

share_title.description: Optional: the title when the link is shared.

site.description: The address of a site on this account (from list_sites).

name: update_site_settings
